title: Approval Queue Item
description: Represents an aggregated actionable item requiring TC or Admin consideration. Sourced dynamically from underlying Document or Transaction state.

queue_item_id.description: Unique ephemeral identifier for the queue item

item_type.description: The category of the pending item

submitted_by_user_id.description: Agent or Partner ID who submitted the item

related_transaction_id.description: Optional TRX ID if this relates to a specific transaction
